referenceUse: Approved style references were inspected. Each new source was generated from the recorded text specification, not from old screenshots.
postProcessing: Mechanical visible-bounds crop (alpha >=16, steam >=4), output padding and uniform downsampling; all original alpha inside crop retained. Original generated PNGs retained unchanged. No matte, recoloring or code-drawn asset substitutes.
sourceRecords: prompts.json records each built-in generated path and workspace source path.
notes: Background is 512x768 because it is a deliberately low-detail environment; full 1024x1536 source retained.
Transparent noise outside visible bounds is excluded during export. Review alpha-audit.json and three background previews.
